utakata 0.2.1 fixes the Android app's setup on phones that refused the files you pick (such as a Galaxy S25), and building the Android app's game from a Windows PC (`--android`). It brings ss-delta 0.5.2's fixes to the shared front end and setup.

## Downloads

| System | Download | Start |
|---|---|---|
| Windows 10/11, x64 | `utakata-v0.2.1-windows.zip` | `shinobido2.exe` |
| Linux x64, Steam Deck | `utakata-v0.2.1-linux.tar.gz` | `shinobido2.x86_64` |
| macOS 13.3+ on Apple Silicon | `utakata-v0.2.1-macos.tar.gz` | `Shinobido 2 - Revenge of Zen.app` |
| Android 9+, 64-bit ARM with Vulkan | `utakata-v0.2.1-android.apk` | **Shinobido 2** (install the APK) |

On a PC, unpack the archive and start the game. The first time, its importer asks for your own dump of Shinobido 2: Revenge of Zen (US PCSE00015, with update 1.02; the Mirror Spirits add-on is optional), downloads the PS Vita firmware from Sony (about 180 MB; the compiler is in the download), and builds the game on your computer in a few minutes. Nothing of the game is in these downloads. See the [installation guide](https://github.com/vita-recomps/utakata/blob/main/docs/INSTALLING.md).

On Android (made for Snapdragon handhelds such as the AYN Thor), install the APK and start it: its setup screen builds the game on the device from your dump. The APK installs over 0.2.0 and keeps your saves.

macOS: the app isn't signed by a registered Apple developer, so macOS refuses it the first time. Open System Settings, Privacy & Security, and click "Open Anyway".

## Fixed

* **Android: the game's files wouldn't install on some phones** ([ss-delta #23](https://github.com/vita-recomps/ss-delta/issues/23)), such as a Galaxy S25: the setup stopped at "Failed to load archive file". The app now reads the files you pick through the access Android's file picker gives it, instead of opening them again by name, which those phones refuse to an app without storage permission.
* **Building the Android app's game from a Windows PC** (`--android`) stopped with `relocation R_AARCH64_ABS64 cannot be used against symbol ...; recompile with -fPIC` in 0.2.0.
* **Graphics cards whose driver has neither shader interlock nor raster-order attachment access** (the log's `Framebuffer reads:` line says "no, no": Qualcomm's own Adreno driver, older AMD Radeon such as the R5 APUs) leave effects that blend with the picture to the card's own blender, or read a copy of the picture, as ss-delta 0.5.2 does against blocks in its smoke and fog. Other cards draw exactly as before. `[debug] shader_blend` on the settings menu's Debug page turns it off if something looks wrong on your card.

## New

* **The log lists every graphics card** Vulkan offers the game, and `[debug] gpu` picks one by its number there (for a laptop that starts on the wrong one).

## Upgrading from 0.2.0

On a PC, unpack 0.2.1 over your game's folder (replace the files), then start the game with `--install` and build again from the same dump. Saves and settings are kept. On Android, install the APK over the old one. See [Updating](https://github.com/vita-recomps/utakata/blob/main/docs/INSTALLING.md#updating).

Every release's changes: [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/vita-recomps/utakata/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

SHA-256 and build attestations: see the files attached, and `gh attestation verify`.
